text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Reunion. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Naran follows Carmen in — The Reunion still stands.

🛡️ Haven's pantry holds 3,784 kcal — about 1.9 days at the current burn. The village must eat first: the demand is refused, not from defiance but from arithmetic.
